QuestInfo.name: Unexpected Encounter
QuestInfo.0: Where was #p2430000# incarcerated? #b#p2430004##k promised to lead the way.
QuestInfo.1: The duo found out that #p2430000# was being held in a cave in the #b#MDmap323090200##k! But they found a big surprise when the Shadow Knights were there!
QuestInfo.2: #p2400005# and #p2400006# fled the scene when they saw the Shadow Knights, but they were at an impasse. #p2400005# wanted to hold off on rescuing the boy, but #p2400006# wanted to rush in right away. Everything was going topsy-turvy!

0.0: Oh, you're back. Look, I'll tell you where Larelle is, but don't tell anybody else. Take the #bportal to #MDmap323090200##k. There's an entrance to a cave under a tree... he's in there.

yes.0: We didn't want to keep him locked up, but those monsters he can summon are just too dangerous. We take him food and water twice a day, and make sure he's got lots to do. He's safe, and that's what's important.
yes.1: I know you two won't hurt the kid. That's the only reason I'm letting you see him.

default.0: Take the #bportal to #MDmap323090200##k. There's an entrance to a cave under a tree.
